reason: The proposed tool call uses modify_pending_order_items with new_item_ids=[] to remove three items from a pending order while keeping the rest. Policy does not support partial removal of items from a pending order: 'Modify items' only allows changing an item to 'an available new item of the same product but of different product option' with a matching new_item_ids list of the same length, and cancellation under 'Cancel pending order' applies to the whole order only ('the order status will be changed to cancelled'). There is no policy-supported action for removing a subset of items from a pending order while retaining others. The conversation also mischaracterizes this as a 'cancellation' of specific items and never obtained confirmation for a proper modify-items action (same-product different-option swap) nor a valid cancellation reason for the whole order. The candidate call is therefore not authorized by any policy procedure.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option.
An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'... After user confirmation, the order status will be changed to 'cancelled'
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders. Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once per order.
